definition: The process keeps its shape. A paper or PDF artefact becomes a credential, and the sequence of steps does not change.
Steps, hand-offs or waiting are removed and the channel may change, but the process is recognisably the same one.
An existing process is materially reorganised around verifiable data, including changes to roles, sequence or information custody.
Enables an activity or operating model that was previously impractical or uneconomic at the required level of trust.
